topThreats.title: CISA Alert: Active Exploitation of Perimeter Gateway & Edge Appliance Vulnerabilities
topThreats.summary: State-sponsored and ransomware actors are actively chaining authentication bypass and unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) flaws in internet-facing perimeter appliances and VPN gateways.
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Review perimeter resilience and external attack surface management. Task Execution: Audit VPN/gateway firmware, enforce MFA on all edge access, and isolate administrative interfaces.

topThreats.title: Global Digital Identity & Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Trust Architecture Review
topThreats.summary: High-velocity threat telemetry tracking root certificate authority store policies, unmonitored code-signing credentials, and enterprise identity federation risks across cloud environments.
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Review third-party digital trust and cryptographic supplier risk (SCRM). Task Execution: Inventory all TLS/code-signing certificates, verify root CA pinning, and automate certificate lifecycle rotation.

topThreats.title: Critical Infrastructure Warning: SCADA/ICS Protocol Ingestion & Boundary Defenses
topThreats.summary: Heightened threat scanning against industrial control systems, Purdue Model Level 2/3 boundary firewalls, and SCADA engineering workstations across energy and utility sectors.
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Validate NIST CSF 2.0 / NERC CIP / 10 CFR 73.54 boundary isolation. Task Execution: Enforce unidirectional or zero-trust Purdue Model conduits, rotate boundary credentials, and monitor engineering workstation logs.

streamItems.title: CISA Adds Critical Remote Code Execution Flaws to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
streamItems.summary: Immediate patching mandated for federal agencies and critical infrastructure operators following active in-the-wild exploitation.
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep. Task Execution: Cross-reference CISA KEV additions against internal vulnerability management telemetry within 24 hours.

streamItems.title: SANS ISC Handler Diary: Elevated Packet Velocity Targeting Unpatched Perimeter Endpoints
streamItems.summary: Honeypots worldwide record coordinated scanning campaigns probing edge routing infrastructure and cloud gateways.
streamItems.remediation: Task Execution: Isolate perimeter management interfaces, inspect firewall drop logs, and verify ingress filtering rules.

streamItems.title: Healthcare Sector Alert: Phishing and Initial Access Brokers Targeting Clinical Systems
streamItems.summary: Ransomware groups leverage stolen credentials to bypass multi-factor authentication and gain persistence in healthcare environments.
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Review HIPAA/HITRUST security controls. Task Execution: Enforce FIDO2 phishing-resistant authentication across all staff and third-party contractors.

streamItems.title: Supply Chain Advisory: Malicious Packages and Dependency Confusion in Cloud Pipelines
streamItems.summary: Security researchers uncover automated weaponization of package managers targeting enterprise software build pipelines.
streamItems.remediation: Task Execution: Enforce private package registries with hash pinning, audit build pipeline permissions, and implement software bill of materials (SBOM) scanning.

streamItems.title: Critical Infrastructure Defenses: Mitigating Living-off-the-Land (LotL) Tactics in Power Grids
streamItems.summary: Adversaries utilize native administrative command-line tools to evade traditional antivirus and EDR detections within substation networks.
streamItems.remediation: Board/Executive: Validate NERC CIP baseline requirements. Task Execution: Implement behavioral baselining, disable unused administrative tools, and forward OT telemetry to SOC.
